answer_1.quote: Extensive experiments show INFO-RAG enhances the zero-shot RAG of LLaMA2 across Question Answering, Slot-Filling, Language Modeling, Dialog, and Code Generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers, dialogues, code, and language modeling outputs

answer_2.quote: We use cover Exact Match (EM) to determine whether the ground truth exactly appears in the output and the accuracy is used as the evaluation metric... For Long-Form Question Answering... ROUGE-L as the evaluation metric... For Dialogue... F1 as the evaluation metric... For Code Generation... CodeBLEU as the evaluation metric.
